name: Pilot Seat (HOTAS)
description: It provides 10 number outputs that produce a standard value ranging from -1 to 1, and 48 on/off outputs. You can get in and out of the pilot seat by interacting with it using [$[action_use_seat]]. Designed for use with HOTAS controllers.
shortDescription: The pilot seat lets you translate controller presses into output signals that can control logic components.

logicNodes.label: Occupied
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on signal if this seat is occupied by a character.

logicNodes.label: Trigger [$[action_trigger]]
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on signal when [$[action_trigger]] is held, and off when it is not.

logicNodes.label: Look X
logicNodes.description: Outputs the character look direction in turns along the X-axis.

logicNodes.label: Look Y
logicNodes.description: Outputs the character look direction in turns along the Y-axis.

logicNodes.label: Axis 1 [$[action_left]]/[$[action_right]]
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between -1 and 1, controlled using [$[action_left]] and [$[action_right]]. [$[action_left]] causes the output value to move towards -1, and [$[action_right]] moves it towards 1.

logicNodes.label: Axis 2 [$[action_up]]/[$[action_down]]
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between -1 and 1, controlled using [$[action_up]] and [$[action_down]]. [$[action_down]] causes the output value to move towards -1, and [$[action_up]] moves it towards 1.

logicNodes.label: Axis 3 [$[action_pedal_left]]/[$[action_pedal_right]]
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between -1 and 1, controlled using [$[action_pedal_left]] and [$[action_pedal_right]]. [$[action_pedal_left]] causes the output value to move towards -1, and [$[action_pedal_right]] moves it towards 1.

logicNodes.label: Axis 4 [$[action_throttle_up]]/[$[action_throttle_down]]
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between -1 and 1, controlled using [$[action_throttle_up]] and [$[action_throttle_down]]. [$[action_throttle_down]] causes the output value to move towards -1, and [$[action_throttle_up]] moves it towards 1.

logicNodes.label: Axis 5
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between -1 and 1, controlled using the controller axis.

logicNodes.label: Axis 6
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between -1 and 1, controlled using the controller axis.

logicNodes.label: Axis 7
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between -1 and 1, controlled using the controller axis.

logicNodes.label: Axis 8
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between -1 and 1, controlled using the controller axis.

logicNodes.label: Seat data
logicNodes.description: Outputs the axis, hotkey and occupied data from the seat. (On/Off 1+ : Hotkeys) (On/Off 31 : Trigger) (On/Off 32 : Occupied) (Value 1 : [$[action_left]]/[$[action_right]]) (Value 2 : [$[action_up]]/[$[action_down]]) (Value 3 : [$[action_pedal_left]]/[$[action_pedal_right]]) (Value 4 : [$[action_throttle_up]]/[$[action_throttle_down]]) (Values 5/6/7/8 : Controller Axes) (Value 9 : Look X)  (Value 10 : Look Y)

logicNodes.label: Headset Video
logicNodes.description: Displays video UI overlay on a helmet mounted display.
